_notes: Labeled set for eval_tool_params.py. 'action' uses the consolidated vocabulary (tool or tool.section/kind); calls from the current tool set are mapped onto it first.
'args' values must match (case-insensitive; a one-item list equals its item); {"any_of": [...]} accepts any option; "__present__" requires any non-null value. 'absent' args must be unset.
'every_call' constraints apply to every call of that action; 'forbid_actions' must not appear; 'ordered' requires the expected calls in order; 'expect_error' allows rejected calls.
An 'expect' step may be {"one_of": [step, ...]}: any one alternative satisfies it.
